ledger.title: Payout is linear in notional from 50,000 to 500,000,000 USDC
ledger.angle: B1 payout curve at and beyond the caps
ledger.precondition: an open ETH-market position with a positive raw PnL at the close BBO
ledger.trigger: signed close (0x2792e706) at a notional from 50,000 to 500,000,000 USDC
ledger.impact: raw and adjusted PnL and the fee are exactly proportional to margin x leverage; the haircut percentage is one value (22.243900%) across the whole sweep; nothing in the close path binds the payout other than the 96-bit market aggregate (underflow control) and the LP bankroll
ledger.missing_observation: the OI cap unit stays unresolved, so the live caps are quoted as raw market-field words and not converted to a USDC notional

ledger.title: Every payout and fee component floors; the split remainder goes to the developer
ledger.angle: B2 rounding direction and the split remainder
ledger.precondition: a profitable close with any fee rate
ledger.trigger: controlled winFeeRate overrides (Exchange slot 24) of 1, 3 and an odd-ratio value
ledger.impact: win fee = floor(adjustedPnl x slot24 / 1e18); the staker share is floor(fee/2) and the developer share is fee - floor(fee/2), so every odd unit goes to the developer. The fee is never rounded up, so no composition rounds in the user's favour
ledger.evidence_tier: port-free Forge replay of the real signed close

ledger.title: Fee accrual starts one fee above the payout threshold, so the fee is dropped between the two
ledger.angle: B3 profit-plus-fee discontinuity on the live library
ledger.precondition: a profitable close whose payout is compared against the LP bankroll
ledger.trigger: the LP bankroll argument (0x0b9370332 arg 8) between (adjusted-fee) and adjusted
ledger.impact: the direct payout threshold is available >= adjustedPnl - fee; the fee is only split to staker and developer at available >= adjustedPnl. Between the two the user is paid the full net win (33224834406638357164981) but no fee is recorded and the LP debit is 13224834406638357164981 instead of 13494728986365670576511: the fee of 269894579727313411530 is dropped from both buckets. The user's total claim is continuous across the boundary, so no user gain exists; the loss falls on the staker and developer buckets and on the LP debit
ledger.evidence_tier: port-free Forge replay of the real signed close with treasury overrides
ledger.missing_observation: no unprivileged actor can set the LP bankroll; the branch needs an owner or keeper action or a natural queue-plus-bankroll state, which is not observed here

ledger.title: Losing close: fee floors from the loss, split floors equally, and the LP credit is the loss less the fee
ledger.angle: B4 fee split and negative PnL
ledger.trigger: controlled lossFeeRate overrides (Exchange slot 23) of 0, 2% and 3 wei
ledger.impact: loss fee = floor(|adjustedPnl| x slot23 / 1e18); the trader receives margin + adjusted; Tokenomics onCloseBatch is called with debit 0 and mintBasis = credit = |adjusted| - fee, so the fee reduces the LP share of the loss and the PAPER mint basis, not the trader credit. A zero rate zeroes the fee and the split
ledger.evidence_tier: port-free Forge replay of the real signed close

ledger.title: A deferred payout is paid exactly once, in full, at harvest
ledger.angle: B5 queue enqueue, harvest and deferral
ledger.precondition: a profitable close with lpBankrollAvailable below the net win
ledger.trigger: the close enqueues the net win; harvest(uint256) is then called twice
ledger.impact: the close pays the margin and enqueues exactly adjustedPnl - fee (13224834406638357164981); the first harvest pays exactly that amount to the balance, reduces totalQueued by the same amount and returns it; the second harvest pays zero. The deferred amount is neither lost nor double counted, and the LP debit is the queued claim, not the gross win
ledger.evidence_tier: port-free Forge replay of the real signed close and harvest
ledger.missing_observation: the library merge and consolidation selectors are exercised only through their Exchange wrappers, and both revert in the sampled two-node states

ledger.title: activateRebate is owner-only, sets one Tokenomics slot, and mints nothing
ledger.angle: B6 new rebate and builder surfaces
ledger.precondition: the set-2 Tokenomics installed behind the existing proxy
ledger.trigger: activateRebate() from the owner, from the guardian multisig, from a stranger, and with one argument
ledger.impact: activateRebate takes no argument, reverts 0x30cd7471 (the NotOwner selector) for a stranger and for the guardian, and from the owner writes exactly one Tokenomics slot (slot 9) and emits one four-word event. Before the call slot 9 and the getter 0x122b6689 read zero; after it both read 1311699483804150265469851653. The PAPER total supply is unchanged (8621543501618220608396651701 before and after), no Tokenomics settlement path runs, and no Exchange or Staking storage is written, so the rebate path mints no token and credits no balance in the observed call
ledger.evidence_tier: port-free exact-runtime replay of the live Tokenomics proxy and implementation
ledger.missing_observation: the source name of slot 9 and the meaning of the four event words are not recovered; the live getter 0x122b6689 is nonzero, so the rebate is already activated on chain

ledger.title: Builder fee plumbing is owner-guarded; whether a builder fee is LP-funded is not settled
ledger.precondition: the set-2 BuilderRegistry and SessionKeyManager wired by the governance batch
ledger.impact: BuilderRegistry.feeRate() is 0.5% on the 1e18 scale; setFeeRate and approveBuilder succeed from the timelock owner and revert for the guardian multisig and a stranger, so the builder fee is owner-only. SessionKeyManager builderRegistry() returns the live registry and setBuilderRegistry is owner-only. Exchange builderFees(address) returns zero for both stalled-sweep users and claimBuilderFees(address) moved no storage and emitted no log at that zero balance. No builder was attached to any close, so the question of a builder fee creating a credit the LP accounting did not pay for is plausible but unproven
ledger.evidence_tier: saved read-only public-RPC probes (current state) plus a port-free exact-runtime replay
ledger.missing_observation: a real close carrying an attached builder with a nonzero builderFees balance would show whether the builder credit has a matching LP debit

ledger.title: Guardian H-02, M-02 and M-04 all behave identically on the set-2 implementations
ledger.angle: B7 regression against the Guardian fixes
ledger.precondition: the same close and liquidation states replayed on the pinned and live runtimes
ledger.trigger: a queued win, a solvent win, and a liquidation with totalQueued zero and one wei
ledger.impact: H-02 holds: the queued win debits Tokenomics by exactly the queued claim (13224834406638357164981). M-04 holds: the solvent win debits the gross adjusted win (13494728986365670576511) and the fee is separately split. M-02 reproduces: with totalQueued zero the liquidation credits 19600000000000000000000 (margin less the 2% liquidation fee, split to staker and developer) and with totalQueued one wei it credits the full margin 20000000000000000000000 with the fee waived. Every number is identical to the pinned implementation in the tested states
ledger.evidence_tier: port-free Forge replays of the real close and liquidation entrypoints on both runtimes
ledger.missing_observation: the side-bucket slot 27 stays zero in both liquidation replays, so the side-bucket allocation REPORT.md measured in its archive replay is not reproduced here; the M-02 branch is decided, the side bucket is not
